{{Top}}
{{Quote|Your vocal machanism is close to ours, but there are clearly some differences. However, I believe I ''could'' teach you to speak Minnisiat. It's a trade language widely used in the regions around our territory.|[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] suggests teaching a trade language to [[Jorj Car'das]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
'''Trade languages''' were common [[Language/Legends|languages]] used by [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] who did not speak a common tongue. In the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]], [[Taarja/Legends|Taarja]], and [[Meese Caulf/Legends|Meese Caulf]] were used as trade languages. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] used Sy Bisti and [[Minnisiat/Legends|Minnisiat]] as trade languages.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> The bio-engineered [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asmeru]] spoke the traders tongue of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] Houses.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
